sampleQuestions.question: Choose the sentence with the correct grammar:
options: Neither of the boys were ready for the test.
Neither of the boys was ready for the test.
Neither of the boys are ready for the test.
Neither of the boys have been ready for the test.
sampleQuestions.simpleExplanation: 'Neither' is singular, so it uses 'was' instead of 'were'.
